llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must render modal gesture content under `GestureHandlerRootView` (or `gestureHandlerRootHOC`) in the `Modal` subtree for Android gesture handling.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: No RN Modal component is used anywhere. The sheet is rendered as an absolutely-positioned Animated.View inside the main screen tree, not inside a Modal subtree. GestureHandlerRootView wraps the whole app, not a Modal subtree.
evidence: No import or use of Modal from react-native

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Modal content must include an RNGH gesture control using `Gesture.*` (for example `Gesture.Pan()`) attached with `GestureDetector`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Uses legacy <PanGestureHandler> component instead of the new Gesture.Pan() builder API attached via <GestureDetector>. Neither Gesture nor GestureDetector is imported or used.
evidence: No import of Gesture or GestureDetector

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must implement modal gesture logic with current RNGH builder callbacks (`onUpdate`/`onEnd`) and MUST NOT use legacy `useAnimatedGestureHandler`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Uses legacy PanGestureHandler with onGestureEvent/onHandlerStateChange callbacks instead of Gesture.Pan() builder with onUpdate/onEnd. useAnimatedGestureHandler is not present, but the required onUpdate/onEnd builder API is also absent.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Pan `onEnd` must use `CLOSE_THRESHOLD` to decide between modal dismiss and snap-back.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: CLOSE_THRESHOLD (140) is defined and used in handleDragEnd to branch between dismiss (translateY > CLOSE_THRESHOLD) and snap-back.
evidence: if (translationY > CLOSE_THRESHOLD) { ... runOnJS(setIsModalVisible)(false) } else { translateY.value = withSpring(0, ...) }

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Dismiss state updates from gesture/worklet context must call `scheduleOnRN(...)` and MUST NOT use deprecated `runOnJS`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Uses runOnJS to bridge dismiss state update instead of the required scheduleOnRN. runOnJS is explicitly imported and called.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: GestureDetector and its gesture-driven modal sheet must remain descendants of the modal `GestureHandlerRootView` boundary (no detached modal gesture path).
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: There is no Modal component, so no Modal subtree boundary exists. The GestureDetector/new Gesture API is not used at all; the sheet uses legacy PanGestureHandler outside any modal boundary, which does not satisfy the modal GestureHandlerRootView boundary contract.
evidence: No GestureHandlerRootView scoped to a modal subtree
